# HVE-Forge for Claude Code

@AGENTS.md

Use the generated HVE subagents under `.claude/agents`, rules under `.claude/rules`, and portable skills under `.claude/skills`.

Claude Code hooks are intentionally not enabled by default. Use the HVE CLI for deterministic policy, replay, evidence, rendering checks, and host diagnostics.
